data.long_meaning: The Igbo name Ngozi means 'peaceful gift of God'. In the Igbo culture, Ngozi is a name given to a child born after a period of turmoil or conflict, symbolizing the return of peace and harmony. The name Ngozi carries the meaning “Peaceful gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Igbo. Parents who choose Ngozi usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ngozi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ngozi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_greek.name: Νγκόζι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νγκόζι είναι Αφρικανικής προέλευσης και σημαίνει 'Δωροδοκία Θεού' ή 'Δώρο του Θεού'. Στην πνευματική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό αντανακλά την πίστη και την ευγνωμοσύνη προς τον Θεό για την ευλογία του παιδιού.

in_latin.name: Ngozi
